heading: China trip cost calculator: 7, 10 and 14-day estimates
intro: Choose your travel days, number of travelers and travel style. Compare the daily-spending subtotal per person with the subtotal for your whole group.
assumptions: Uses this guide's existing ChinaEase planning ranges for accommodation, meals, local transport, ordinary attractions and small daily expenses. These are estimates, not live prices or official averages.
excludedCosts: Add intercity trains or domestic flights, international flights, insurance, visa costs where applicable, shopping, fees and a contingency separately. Daily-cost subtotals differ from the full-trip envelopes further down, which include a broad intercity allowance.
roomNote: The group estimate applies the same per-person range to every traveler. It does not calculate a shared-room discount or child price. Replace assumptions with actual room and ticket quotes before booking.
examplesNote: Each cell is for one person over the full number of days shown, excluding the separate costs listed above. The comfortable range has an open upper end.
itineraryLinkText: Choose 14 days and your group size, then add the live prices for your intercity route and flights separately.

faq.question: How can I calculate a China travel budget for two people?
faq.answer: Choose your days, travel style and two travelers in the calculator. It shows both per-person and group daily-spending subtotals. Accommodation is already part of the daily range; use actual shared-room quotes to refine it, then add intercity tickets, international flights and other excluded costs separately.
